# Empirical scope of encounter control and retained use / 经历控制与保留使用的经验范围

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`encounter-control-and-retention` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F09 · [record](encounter-control-and-retention.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Reanalysis of the public CuriGaze inclusion sample, 75 participants and 451 trials, gives Curiosity−Yoked target-looking change of −1.34 percentage points, conventional 95% Welch interval [−10.38,+7.69]. This constrains an automatic selection-to-learning-advantage correspondence.
>
> 公开CuriGaze正式纳入75人、451试次的复算中，主动条件相对配对条件的目标注视变化差为−1.34个百分点，常规95% Welch区间为[−10.38,+7.69]。它约束选择自动产生学习优势的经验对应。

## Conditions / 条件

- Use the authors’ cleaned inclusion list joined to trial records, averaging within participants first. Retain the earlier 77-person export as sensitivity; do not select rows to fit a desired finding.<br>按作者清理名单与试次表共同字段纳入；先在参与者内平均。77人的较早导出另存敏感性，不择行追随期望结论。
- Conventional t/Welch intervals condition on participant independence. Pair identities are unavailable, sequential-design coverage is unproved, and randomized participant allocation is not established.<br>常规t/Welch区间以参与者独立为条件；配对身份未获得，顺序采样覆盖率未证明，参与者随机分配未确立。
- Exploratory secondary analysis after the paper was known. Change in target looking is not proportion of words learned and does not alone identify comprehension, recognized control or a retention mechanism.<br>论文已知后的探索性二次分析；目标注视变化不是学习词数比例，也不独自识别概念理解、控制识别或保留机制。

## Does not show / 未表明

- It establishes neither a retention advantage nor equivalence.<br>未建立保留优势或等效。
- It does not identify a unique psychological mechanism or social cause.<br>不识别唯一心理机制或社会原因。
- It does not identify long-term memory, consciousness or evolutionary origin.<br>不识别长期记忆、意识或演化起源。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Intervals admit positive and negative differences and cannot establish equivalence. Two log-omission reasons and pair mappings are unknown. Raw trajectories are not reprocessed; table-SD discrepancies and singleton multiple-adjustment code are disclosed.<br>区间容许正负差异，不足以认定等效；两人的名单遗漏原因与配对关系不明。原始轨迹未复算，论文表中SD差异和单值多重校正问题明示。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/contingent-learning/README.md)

## Evidence / 证据

Eight small originals match OSF hashes; the cleaned log comes from a verified archive. Separate CSV/Decimal calculations reconstruct proportions, participant means, variances, ANOVA and Welch arithmetic, sharing SciPy distribution functions. Substantive author counterreview completed; no independent-agent acceptance or new Lean proof.<br>八个原始小文件与OSF哈希匹配；清理名单来自已验证压缩包。独立CSV/Decimal运算重构比例、参与者均值、方差、ANOVA及Welch算术，分布函数共用SciPy。作者实质反审完成，无独立agent验收或新Lean证明。

## Next / 下一步

Building on the preserved conditional connections, identify how formed access and retained source/order information guide actual use in a matched developmental procedure, distinguishing present reliance from old-content endorsement.<br>在保留的既有条件连接之上，于匹配发育程序中识别已取得访问及所保留来源／次序如何进入实际使用，分别观察当前依赖与旧内容认可。

### Correspondence / 对应

Control, effective access, retention and evidence admission are distinct roles within one history. Matched displays do not establish equal retained inputs; a positive pointing comparison does not identify a single social cause across different studies.<br>控制、有效取得、保留和证据接纳是同一经历史中的不同作用关系。显示内容相同未证明保留输入相同；另一指点研究的积极结果不把跨研究差异识别为单一社会因果。
